scientific_integrity: All displayed degenerations and flattening identities are proved symbolically. Representative exact finite calculations supplement, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem describes only sufficiency of maximal multilinear rank for semistability of equal-dimensional one-hyperedge representations, not the full moduli quotient. Classical tensor null-cone theory may contain an implicit all-format version; this historical possibility remains open.
title: A sharp valence boundary for full-rank tensor semistability
